Explanation: The core value unit is a Gig: a defined freelance service with a scope, price, delivery time and expected output that a buyer can order.
Fiverr operates the global marketplace, sets marketplace rules and coordinates discovery, ordering, payments, reviews and support.
Fiverr has to turn many different freelance skills into services that buyers can find, understand and purchase.
More successful orders create marketplace revenue and give buyers and freelancers reasons to return.
Poor delivery, fraud or misleading offers can quickly reduce trust in a marketplace where the work is delivered remotely.
Fiverr processes marketplace orders and earns transaction revenue from buyer and seller fees.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Order / Pay — The buyer chooses a Gig or custom offer and pays through Fiverr. | → Consumer · Search / Order — Fiverr makes services searchable, comparable and purchasable through the catalog and checkout. | ← Provider · Gigs / Work — Freelancers publish service offers and deliver completed work through the marketplace. | → Provider · Orders / Payout — Fiverr brings paid orders to freelancers and releases their earnings after completion.

Explanation: Fiverr sets service, account and conduct rules and uses ratings, reviews and quality controls to govern the marketplace.
Fiverr brings buyers to the marketplace through search, advertising, content and its own recommendation systems.
Fiverr organizes the service catalog, matches demand, processes orders and payments, and supports disputes and delivery.
The marketplace relies on Fiverr's brand, catalog, buyer and seller data, search systems, payments and reviews.
Buyers are individuals and businesses purchasing digital freelance services such as design, programming, marketing, video, writing and AI services.
Buyers want a specific piece of work completed without having to recruit an employee or run a long sourcing process.
A searchable catalog, visible prices, packages, reviews and delivery times make many services easier to compare and order.
The buyer may not know in advance whether the freelancer will fully understand the brief, deliver on time or meet the expected quality.
The buyer selects a Gig or custom offer and pays through Fiverr.
Transaction Flows: → Owner · Order / Pay — The buyer chooses a Gig or custom offer and pays through Fiverr. | ← Owner · Search / Order — Fiverr makes services searchable, comparable and purchasable through the catalog and checkout. | ← Provider · Service — The freelancer delivers the agreed digital service to the buyer.

Explanation: A useful offer has to fit the buyer's required skill, scope, timing, quality expectations and budget.
Buyers discover services through Fiverr search, categories, recommendations and higher-touch Fiverr Pro experiences.
Buyers compare services, choose packages, share a brief, communicate, approve delivery and leave reviews.
Buyers contribute the project brief, budget, files, feedback and payment.
Freelancers create Gigs and deliver digital services to buyers around the world.
Freelancers want to turn their skills into paid work and reach buyers beyond their own personal network.
Fiverr gives freelancers global discovery, ordering, payment infrastructure and a reputation they can build through completed work.
Freelancers compete on visibility, price, ratings and delivery quality and may depend heavily on marketplace demand.
Freelancers deliver the agreed service and receive their share of the order value after completion.
Transaction Flows: → Owner · Gigs / Work — Freelancers publish service offers and deliver completed work through the marketplace. | ← Owner · Orders / Payout — Fiverr brings paid orders to freelancers and releases their earnings after completion. | → Consumer · Service — The freelancer delivers the agreed digital service to the buyer. | ← Partner · Payout — External payout providers can transfer Fiverr earnings to the freelancer.

Explanation: Freelancers and Gigs must fit Fiverr categories, quality requirements and platform rules; some categories are vetted.
Freelancers use Fiverr tools to create Gigs, manage orders, communicate with buyers and track earnings.
Freelancers design service packages, answer buyers, complete the work, revise it when needed and maintain their ratings.
Freelancers contribute their expertise, portfolio, working time, tools and reputation.
External payment and payout providers help Fiverr move money between a global buyer base and freelancers in many countries.
Payment partners have to support reliable checkout and freelancer withdrawals across countries, currencies and banking systems.
Fiverr creates transaction and payout volume for payment networks and financial service providers.
Cross-border payments bring fraud, identity checks, country restrictions, compliance requirements and currency conversion complexity.
Payment partners process buyer payments or transfer freelancer earnings out of Fiverr.
Transaction Flows: → Provider · Payout — External payout providers can transfer Fiverr earnings to the freelancer.

Explanation: A payment provider has to support the user's country, currency and required verification rules.
Fiverr supports external payout methods including PayPal and Payoneer, with availability depending on location.
Partners authorize payments, move funds, handle withdrawals and apply their own compliance controls.
Payment partners contribute payment rails, bank connections, identity processes and local financial coverage.
